import hashlib
import json
import statistics
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

work = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root = work.parents[1]

def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

paired = read(work/'paired-evidence.json')
previous = read(root/'docs/reports/windows-x64-2026-10-18-pad-end-optimization.json')
baseline_dir = work/'baseline-source'
for path in ['src/runtime/nchw.rs','src/runtime/nchw/pad_end2.rs']:
    original = subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'HEAD:{path}'],cwd=root)
    assert (baseline_dir/path).read_bytes().replace(b'\r\n',b'\n') == original.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
for item in previous['candidate']['sources']:
    if item['path'].startswith('src/'):
        assert digest(root/item['path']) == item['sha256'], item['path']
assert digest(root/'examples/cpu_owner_probe.rs') == digest(baseline_dir/'examples/cpu_owner_probe.rs')
for item in paired['executables'].values():
    assert digest(Path(item['path'])) == item['sha256'].lower()

plans = {p.stem:read(p) for p in work.glob('plan-*.json') if p.stat().st_size}
assert len(plans) == 9
plan_counts = {}
for name, plan in plans.items():
    assert plan['inference_calls'] == 0
    count = sum(k['steps'] for k in plan['statistics']['specialized_kernels'] if k['family'] == 'nchw_dense_2x2_pad_end')
    assert count == (1 if name == 'plan-tiny-det' else 0), name
    plan_counts[name] = count

rows = []
for case in paired['cases']:
    before = [v['milliseconds'] for v in case['samples']['baseline']]
    after = [v['milliseconds'] for v in case['samples']['current']]
    assert len(before) == len(after) == 3
    hashes = [case['warmups'][v]['output_sha256'] for v in ['baseline','current']]
    hashes += [s['output_sha256'] for v in ['baseline','current'] for s in case['samples'][v]]
    assert len(set(hashes)) == 1
    old_page = next(p for p in previous['candidate']['pages'] if p['case'] == case['case'])
    assert hashes[0] == old_page['baseline']['control_output_sha256'] == old_page['candidate']['control_output_sha256']
    for key in ['retained_activation_bytes','retained_workspace_bytes','retained_kernel_scratch_bytes_subset_of_workspace']:
        assert case['reports']['baseline']['cases'][0][key] == case['reports']['current']['cases'][0][key]
    rows.append(dict(model=case['case'][0],fixture=case['case'][1],baseline_ms=before,current_ms=after,
                     baseline_median_ms=statistics.median(before),current_median_ms=statistics.median(after),
                     median_change_percent=(statistics.median(after)/statistics.median(before)-1)*100,
                     baseline_mean_ms=statistics.mean(before),current_mean_ms=statistics.mean(after),
                     mean_change_percent=(statistics.mean(after)/statistics.mean(before)-1)*100,
                     paired_changes_percent=[(b/a-1)*100 for a,b in zip(before,after)],output_sha256=hashes[0]))
sources = subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','-c','-o','--exclude-standard','src','examples','tools','Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','rust-toolchain.toml'],cwd=root,text=True).splitlines()
current_sources = [dict(path=p,sha256=digest(root/p)) for p in sorted(set(sources))]
baseline_sources = [dict(path=str(p.relative_to(baseline_dir)).replace('\\','/'),sha256=digest(p)) for p in sorted(baseline_dir.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()]
logs = {name:(work/name).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig') for name in [
    'build-current.log','build-baseline-isolated.log','build-plan-probe.log',
    'test-pad-end.log','test-baseline-pad-end.log','test-protocol-reject.log']}
assert 'test result: ok. 7 passed' in logs['test-pad-end.log']
assert 'test result: ok. 6 passed' in logs['test-baseline-pad-end.log']
assert 'paired mode requires exactly one owner and batch configuration' in logs['test-protocol-reject.log']
combined = dict(
    baseline=previous['baseline_total_performance_execution_seconds'] + paired['conservative_process_seconds']['baseline'],
    current=previous['candidate']['total_performance_execution_seconds'] + paired['conservative_process_seconds']['current'])
assert max(combined.values()) < 60
report = dict(schema_version=1,date='2026-10-18',finding='No repeatable 10.6% Medium regression; current evidence supports benchmark variation. Tiny improvement retained.',
    paired=paired,derived=rows,plans=plans,plan_pad_end_counts=plan_counts,model_census=read(work/'model-census.json'),
    current_sources=current_sources,baseline_sources=baseline_sources,validation_logs=logs,
    plan_probe_executable_sha256=digest(root/'target/release/examples/cpu_plan_probe.exe'),
    current_runtime_sources_match_prior_benchmarked_candidate=True,
    baseline_runtime_matches_head=True,source_line_ending_normalization='CRLF -> LF when comparing archived Windows source with git blobs; all recorded file hashes cover original bytes.',paired_harness_identical_between_versions=True,
    conservative_combined_performance_seconds=combined,
    prior_evidence='windows-x64-2026-10-18-pad-end-optimization.json',
    harness_source=(root/'examples/cpu_owner_probe.rs').read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
    plan_probe_source=(root/'examples/cpu_plan_probe.rs').read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
    report_generator=Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
(root/'docs/reports/windows-x64-2026-10-18-medium-regression.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
